macros.name: InlineCommentsWithPercent
macros.doc: \InlineCommentsWithPercent - same as option 'inline', but can be switched everywhere.

macros.name: normalInlineComments
macros.doc: \normalInlineComments - switch back to normal gmdoc behaviour for inline comments.

macros.name: normalInput
macros.doc: \normalInput{<file>} - inputs <file> (if existing), but with normal LaTeX catcode conventions active.

macros.name: setVisibleCommentChar
macros.doc: \setVisibleCommentChar{<marker>} - set the visible comment marker character to <marker>.

macros.name: setVisibleCommentColor
macros.doc: \setVisibleCommentColor[<model>]{<color>} - indicate which color to use for commented out code.
